normalization.camel_boundary: insert underscore between a lowercase ASCII letter or digit and an uppercase ASCII letter before casefold
normalization.separators: replace each non-Unicode-alphanumeric run with one underscore; trim outer underscores

eligibility.predicted: leaf must descend from an explicitly declared array of objects; retain its nearest repeated-object parent path as the group ID
eligibility.reference: leaf must be annotated as a linked array[object] field; use its declared row group, or one synthetic reference group only when the annotation has a single implicit row group
eligibility.other_shapes: do not apply these aliases to scalar or scalar-list fields

unlisted_leaf: literal normalized name; exact equality only
price_safety: price_unspecified never equals unit_price or line_amount
collision: if more than one predicted or reference leaf maps to a slot, leave that slot unmatched and record the collision; never choose by gold value, row content, document family, or predicted confidence
